Cirencester, United Kingdom243 contributions

Design over substance
Feb 2020
I'd identified a couple of Skybars in the city but we ended up in this one. After being escorted off the street to the lifts by a freezing young woman, we were met at the top of the stairs by a Maitre D' who told me I couldn't come in in flipflops. (As this bar wasn't on our original list, I hadn't investigated dress codes!). He offered me a pair of ballet slippers which were obviously never going to fit a Western size 7, then a pair of men's Zara slip-ons ... both left feet! I eventually got the right foot and he showed us out to the open air part. I asked a waitress if we could sit at a table by the edge and she deferred to the Maitre D who didn't seem interested! The biggest disappointment was the beer - no local beers available at all. We ordered two bottles of Bud at 30,000 VND (around £10) - far and away the most pricey beers of the whole two weeks trip. The views are staggering and the moon came up, but other members of our group found better Skybars with cheaper, local beer.

One of the best rooftop in saigon
May 2019 • Couples
I went to this place on the Friday night.

This place gives you the beautiful view of saigon city. 
 
Music and dance performances, both were amazing.
In cocktail, I ordered LIIT. It was so good and strong. 
In starters, there are not that many options in vegetation so just tried garlic bread.

Staff was humble and service was quick.

In terms of cost, yeah it is little costly.

Overall, I had fun on the Friday night.
